prompts.title: Radha’s Grace
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image ONLY as the facial identity reference.

Preserve the woman’s exact facial structure, proportions, skin tone, eyes, nose, lips, and overall likeness with high accuracy.

Do not beautify, stylize, or alter facial features in any way.

Her expression must remain calm, divine, and slightly smiling — peaceful, compassionate, and serene.
All other elements (pose, outfit, jewelry, hair, props, background, lighting, atmosphere, camera, and color tone) must follow the description below.
Scene Concept
Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic divine portrait inspired by Radha–Krishna aesthetics, portraying the woman as a goddess-like Radha figure with devotional realism.
Background & Environment
A grand Vrindavan-style temple and palace complex fills the background, softly blurred yet clearly recognizable with domes, arches, carved stone details, and sacred architecture.

The temple is illuminated by warm golden and amber oil-lamp light, creating a glowing spiritual aura.

Floating diyas, soft golden bokeh orbs, and subtle light particles surround the scene.

The night sky is a deep indigo-blue, enhancing contrast and divinity.

A faint mist adds a celestial presence without overpowering realism.
Divine Lighting
Warm golden temple lighting combined with a soft ethereal glow around the subject.

A gentle frontal key light clearly illuminates the face.

A soft rim light outlines her silhouette, forming a subtle halo effect.

Shadows remain smooth and natural.

Overall tone is devotional, golden, cinematic, with realistic skin texture and fabric highlights.
Pose & Composition
Vertical portrait, 4:5 aspect ratio.

Medium framing from mid-torso upward.

She stands gracefully with relaxed shoulders.

Head slightly tilted, eyes looking directly at the viewer.

Posture conveys devotion, grace, and divine calm.
Outfit (Radha-Inspired)
She wears a white and gold embroidered lehenga or anarkali, symbolizing purity and divinity.

A soft pink dupatta with heavy gold borders is draped elegantly over one shoulder and flows naturally along her side.

Fabric appears rich, flowing, and finely detailed with realistic embroidery.
Jewelry & Divine Adornments
Traditional handcrafted gold jewelry including:

– A delicate gold necklace

– Ornate gold earrings

– Stacked bangles

– A centered maang tikka

Jewelry looks sacred and artisanal, not overly glossy.
Hair & Floral Details
Hair styled in a long side braid resting over the shoulder.

The braid is adorned with white jasmine flowers and soft pink blossoms.

A single peacock feather is subtly placed near the crown or braid, symbolizing Krishna’s presence.
Sacred Props
She gently holds a wooden bansuri (Krishna’s flute) at mid-torso height.

Peacock feathers rest naturally against the flute.

Hands are relaxed and devotional, not performing or playing.
Mood & Style
Divine • Serene • Devotional • Mythological realism

Ultra-realistic cultural photography

Cinematic depth of field

Sharp facial focus

Soft glowing background

Rich warm color palette

Authentic Radha–Krishna inspired sacred Indian aesthetic

images.alt: Gemini AI Generated Image: A hyper-realistic digital illustration of a smiling young woman in traditional Indian attire, reminiscent of Radha. She wears a white blouse with gold embroidery and a pink drape, adorned with gold jewelry including a necklace, earrings, and a maang tikka. Her long braid is decorated with white jasmine and pink flowers, with a peacock feather tucked into her hair. She holds a bamboo flute and peacock feathers in her hands. The background is filled with a warm, golden glow, featuring floating oil lamps (diyas) and blurred temple silhouettes, creating a festive and divine atmosphere.

prompts.title: Cinematic traditional lord krishna
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face and identity reference.
A subject is positioned slightly left of center, with the body subtly angled toward the right side of the frame and the gaze directed upward to the right, carrying a soft, joyful, and serene smile. The subject is dressed in a traditional pastel blue lehenga set adorned with intricate gold embroidery—the blouse richly detailed with fine gold patterns, paired with a flowing matching skirt and a sheer dupatta draped elegantly over the arms. Accessories include a floral garland of white and yellow flowers around the neck, matching floral wrist adornments, a traditional maang tikka, and large ornate jhumka earrings. The hair is styled in soft, natural waves, slightly side-swept with gentle volume, enhancing the overall elegance.
Behind the subject, an off-white textured wall serves as a soft, diffused canvas where a large, artistic shadow silhouette of a figure playing a flute is cast—symbolic, poetic, and clearly visible while remaining softly blended into the background. The environment is enriched with subtle greenery and warm ambient elements, such as faint candlelight hints, enhancing the festive and romantic mood. The lighting follows a warm golden-hour inspiration, with a soft directional key light illuminating the face and outfit, creating gentle falloff for depth while preserving natural skin tones and highlighting the embroidery details. The off-white wall remains slightly darker in gradient to create contrast, allowing the shadow silhouette to stand out distinctly.
The composition is a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio medium-full portrait (mid-thigh to slightly above the head), ensuring no cropping at the head or hands. The subject occupies approximately 65–70% of the frame height, with balanced negative space and a shallow depth of field that produces a smooth, cinematic background blur. The overall mood is romantic, festive, and culturally elegant, with a dreamy cinematic tone, rendered in ultra-high detail, 8K quality, featuring natural textures and realistic skin with visible pores, avoiding any plastic or overly processed look, and finished with a professional photography aesthetic.
